Name: Ore Spawn Control
Author: Shnmg33
Description:
Ore Spawn Control
Ore Spawn Control is a configurable resource-spawning mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.x. It lets players customize how ores, gems, geodes, and Volcano resources appear, making mining progression easier to tailor to different playstyles.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Supports the Mines, Skull Cavern, Quarry Mine, and Volcano Dungeon.[/*]
[*]Controls copper, iron, gold, iridium, coal, and radioactive ore nodes.[/*]
[*]Controls amethyst, aquamarine, jade, emerald, ruby, topaz, diamond, and generic gem nodes.[/*]
[*]Supports geodes, frozen geodes, magma geodes, omni geodes, mystic stones, cinder shards, Volcano gem nodes, and mussel nodes.[/*]
[*]Provides a global resource multiplier ranging up to 100x[/*]
[*]Allows each resource to be enabled or disabled individually.[/*]
[*]Provides independent multipliers and base spawn chances for each resource.[/*]
[*]Supports a minimum resource-node target for each location.[/*]
[*]Limits the total number of nodes added to each location.[/*]
[*]Includes a force mode that converts ordinary stones into a selected resource type.[/*]
[*]Supports cross-resource conversion, allowing higher-multiplier resources to replace lower-multiplier resource nodes.[/*]
[*]Supports custom resource rules through  config.json[/*]
[*]Uses deterministic random generation, preventing the same location from being repeatedly processed on the same day.[/*]
[*]Only the host changes map objects in multiplayer, reducing synchronization issues.[/*]
[/list][heading]How It Works[/heading]
This mod does not directly replace or rewrite Stardew Valley’s original mine-generation methods. Instead, after a supported location or mine floor has loaded, it scans the existing breakable stones and converts some of them into resource nodes according to the configured probabilities, multipliers, and limits.
The game’s original resource nodes are preserved. Disabling a resource or lowering its multiplier only reduces the number of nodes added by this mod; it does not turn existing resources back into ordinary stones. This approach also reduces the risk of conflicts with other mods that modify mines or map generation.
[heading]Generic Mod Config Menu Support[/heading]
Ore Spawn Control supports Generic Mod Config Menu. With GMCM installed, the following options can be configured directly in-game:
[list]
[*]Master mod toggle[/*]
[*]Global resource multiplier[/*]
[*]Individual resource toggles[/*]
[*]Per-resource multipliers and base probabilities[/*]
[*]Affected locations[/*]
[*]Minimum resource-node target[/*]
[*]Maximum added nodes per location[/*]
[*]Maximum stone conversion rate[/*]
[*]Cross-resource conversion[/*]
[*]Force spawning mode[/*]
[/list]GMCM is optional. If it is not installed, the mod will continue to work and load its settings from 
[code]config.json[/code].
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional, but recommended[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Download the latest release.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into:[/*]
[/list]Stardew Valley/Mods/OreSpawnControl
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod in-game.[/*]
